criteria_location: Coverage, pp.1-2 only. The remaining ~3,100 lines are description, FDA tables, evidence review and references.
procedures_covered: RF kyphoplasty, other mechanical devices, vertebral body stenting (investigational)

logic.top_level: pathways (vertebroplasty list; kyphoplasty list incl. an ALL block for osteoporotic VCF)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Embedded as imaging absences inside the osteoporotic kyphoplasty criterion: stenosis >20% from retropulsion, collapse to <1/3, vertebra plana >90%, anatomy preventing access, burst fracture with retropulsion.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Vertebral compression fracture due to osteoporosis or osteopenia when ALL the following requirements are met: ... and; ... and; ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Bullets end with 'and' while sub-list 1-5 are items of 'absence of' (so each must be absent: reads as NOT any of the 5, 'or' between them)

and_or_ambiguity.quote: considered experimental, investigational and/or unproven for all other indications, including use in acute vertebral fractures due to osteoporosis or trauma
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Acute osteoporotic fracture excluded, yet criterion requires 'acute compression fracture' on imaging

requirement_kinds.quote: has not responded to at least 6 weeks of conservative medical management (e.g., analgesics, physical therapy, rest)
Recent onset of back pain localized to the fracture site
Tenderness to palpation directly over the fracture site
Advanced imaging studies confirming a non-traumatic, acute compression fracture
Recent imaging studies (MRI or CT) which eliminate disc herniation or other causes of spine pain
Spinal stenosis of greater than 20% due to retropulsed fragments
Vertebral body collapse to less than one third (33%) original height
when chemotherapy or radiation therapy has failed to relieve symptoms
Eosinophilic granuloma with pain and spinal instability

thresholds.quote: at least 6 weeks of conservative medical management
less than one third (33%) original height

time_windows.quote: at least 6 weeks of conservative medical management

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT and HCPCS listed in generic Coding block, not tied to criteria

external_dependencies.quote: Carefully check state regulations and/or the member contract.

vague_terms.quote: NOT involving a major part of the cortical bone

extraction_hazards: 3,159 lines, criteria only on first 2 pages
Nested bullets with 'o' sub-bullets and numbered sub-list
Criteria split by page break after 'Policy Guidelines' heading
interesting_structures: Stronger imaging gates for osteoporotic kyphoplasty than for vertebroplasty
Oncology indications require failure of chemo or radiation
Vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty use different criteria sets

fit_to_tree.why: Explicit all/any/not with numeric imaging thresholds, but depends on radiology report reading.
